themes.evidence: turn it into a working agentic workflow without external engineering resources
Orchestration: LangChain or similar agentic frameworks
translate complex technical AI patterns into clear business value and ROI for stakeholders
build dashboards to track SLAs/SLOs — latency, accuracy, uptime — and monitor usage, cost, error rates
coordinate AI project execution across Talent, Support, Sales, Go-To-Market
drive them from concept to measurable business outcome

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is a 'scrappy builder' who independently builds and deploys POCs and turns stakeholder ideas into working agentic workflows using LangChain, vector DBs, and the modern AI stack — hands-on agent construction is the core function, not client embedding or pure analytics.
notes: Role sits inside IT/internal digital transformation (internal use cases, not customer-facing product), and carries a heavy AI-ops/governance half — token management, prompt libraries, cost/SLA monitoring — so 'leverage' (maximizing enterprise AI spend value) is a near-miss theme worth noting downstream.
